title: ON.energy yellow footer card
description: A yellow footer card floating over a dark pattern of hairline circles and grid lines: a two-line tagline and black button at the top-left, a column of big weight-300 links with hairline rules and small dotted chevrons on the right, small icon links, a giant bold wordmark in the bottom-left and a dotted legal line. On phones the card runs full width with only its bottom corners rounded.
notes: the pattern is drawn with CSS gradients in the border colour on the card colour
the wordmark is plain text in the display face; swap in your own mark if you have one
